title: Kitchen Chess
style: Soft rock with female vocals, mid-tempo swung groove and light percussion under orchestral swells; verse rides fingerpicked acoustic, muted bass, and glassy piano, pre-chorus opens with strings and rising toms, chorus blooms with layered harmonies and warm electric guitar. Close-mic lead with airy doubles, intimate ad-lib tails, and soft gang oohs on the hook. Ear candy includes paddle-click foley, a brushed cymbal lift into choruses, and a subtle nature-bed of court birds and wind. Bright, polished, and spacious mix with soft-rock sheen., soft rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
White lines in the morning
Dink by dink, I learn
The faster I swing first
The faster I get burned
Little ball, big lesson
Hands can lie to me
But the court keeps telling
Slow is how I see

[Pre-Chorus]
Two shots ahead
I can feel it now
Three shots ahead
I know the way somehow
Eyes on the gap
Not the muscle, not the pride
Wait for the corner
Then step in time

[Chorus]
Play it with your head
Play it with your head
Not with your strength
Not with your strength
Three shots ahead
Three shots ahead
Attack when it opens
Only when it’s dead

(Only when it’s dead)
(Three shots ahead)

[Verse 2]
Stacked up at the kitchen
I can read the spin
A soft little reset
Can turn the tide again
You hit like thunder
I move like a plan
One small angle changes
What a big drive can’t

[Pre-Chorus]
Two shots ahead
I can feel it now
Three shots ahead
I know the way somehow
Eyes on the gap
Not the muscle, not the pride
Wait for the corner
Then step in time

[Chorus]
Play it with your head
Play it with your head
Not with your strength
Not with your strength
Three shots ahead
Three shots ahead
Attack when it opens
Only when it’s dead

(Only when it’s dead)
(Three shots ahead)

[Bridge]
I used to chase every fire
Every loud temptation
Now I let the point come to me
Built on patience
If you rush the doorway
You leave it wide
I’m calm as the morning
And sharp inside

[Final Chorus]
Play it with your head
Play it with your head
Not with your strength
Not with your strength
Three shots ahead
Three shots ahead
Attack when it opens
Only when it’s dead

(Play it with your head)
(Three shots ahead)
